relationships.kaito-ayatsuji: Teacher who tells him to use Ayatsuji swordsmanship as a tool rather than imitate the school.

relationships.sara-bloodlily: Prior Seven Stars opponent whose match convinced Moroboshi that Kuraudo had grown.

periods.summary: Kuraudo is at Ayatsuji dojo when Okuma attacks and later attends the special conscription debrief after being excluded from active deployment for bad conduct. Moroboshi challenges him to a spar, intrigued by the resolve Kuraudo showed at Seven Stars. Kuraudo's Marginal Counter, the huge variable body of Orochimaru, and his violent adaptation of Ayatsuji Ten'i Muhou counter Moroboshi's spear range, Hahakiboshi, Tiger Bite and blind-spot thrusts. By shortening Orochimaru into twin daggers and using Yamatano Orochi at close range, he defeats Moroboshi. Even so, he is disturbed because Moroboshi's final Unrivaled Single Stroke gave off a fearsome aura that might have ended differently had Kuraudo not struck first.

key_events.summary: Watches Ayase fight Okuma and teases her afterward.
Defeats Moroboshi after adapting Ayatsuji techniques into brute-force offense.
